notes.title: Goodbye, The Tribe. Hello, Tribal Pass.
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 
2017 started weird, we got request from lawyers of the game called "The Tribez" and they urged us to change our game title to avoid trademark infringement. We will publish an article about this incident, but now we just change our name to avoid legal consequences. So, goodbye, The Tribe. Hello, Tribal Pass.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25710448/524afd4897fa60b74667a3423f85a4ca172e91ec.jpg[/img]

notes.title: TRICK OR MEAT!
notes.notes:
Only this festive week, celebrating All Hallows' Eve (and the annual world-wide october madness), The Tribe gets a new run mode – ALL HALLOWS' RUN!

These jolly runs take place at NIGHT ONLY, – and thus are more interesting and more difficult.
Also, All Hallows' Run gets it's own SEPARATE LEADERBOARD, which is not-all-that-easy to champion!

So, fearless tribe leaders, put your masks and costumes on, grab your spears and little baskets, and run from deer to deer, from bonfire to bonfire, and greet everyone you meet with a traditional, a festive, a primevally frolicsome "TRICK OR MEAT?!"

notes.title: Pre-release update
Pre-release update
Pre-release announcement
notes.notes: Hey guys and girls. Today we should announce something that you are probably not going to like. A lot of stuff happens after The Tribe came out into the Steam Early Access, and now as a team we have a difficult situation. We can't afford a development of the Tribe, so we have to choose between staying in EA forever without progress and releasing our game as it is with some polishing and bugfix, and we chose the second option. We failed at delivering all features we wanted to deliver, so the best we can do now - release a solid game from what we have. So in a few days there will be a full release for The Tribe without any major features being added, just some balancing and bugfix is expected. We apologize to everyone who expected The Tribe bigger and content-rich game, however the only way for us to survive as a team is releasing it as a small arcade runner. Sorry again, believe us, it was a hard decision, and no one of us is happy about it. Thank you for being with us!

We noticed that almost no one reads the texts of the Night passing screen, so we are making the night decision easier. Also looks like we should abandon quests at all. It is hard to say it, but perhaps we should focus on core gameplay and encounters rather than text events which are hard to make and not interesting for a large part of our players. Update with all this stuff should come in a few days, stay tuned and have a good run!

notes.notes:
Hey Tribe!
We made our first hotfix and it is about manual control mode. Some of you noticed, that it is much easier to play with 2-3 tribesmen, and completed a whole game with this mode. Now small tribes run with the same rules as a big one. 
Have a good run!
The Tribe Tea(m)
